method: Gemini Images browser interface; one generated reference per style
base_prompt: Create one photorealistic square salon hairstyle reference image for a haircut catalog. A single fictional adult, head and shoulders, slight three-quarter view so top and sides are clearly visible, entire hair silhouette within frame with margin. Soft even studio light, natural skin and hair texture, matte warm ivory background, simple dark forest-green crewneck, neutral relaxed expression. No written labels, no logos, no collage, no extra people. This is a generic hairstyle example, not a real client or celebrity.

styles.classic_buzz: Style: Classic Buzz. Subject: adult man with medium-brown skin and dark hair. An even very short buzz cut, approximately 10 mm top and 7 mm sides, no skin fade, clean natural outline, minimal height. Generate the image now.
styles.tapered_crew: Style: Tapered Crew Cut. Subject: fictional adult man with light olive skin and straight brown hair. Tidy 25 mm short top, slightly longer upright front, 9 mm sides blending gradually with a conservative taper around ears and neckline, no disconnected undercut. Generate a new standalone image.
styles.textured_crop: Style: Textured Crop. Subject: fictional adult man with warm tan skin and wavy dark brown hair. A short compact 35 mm top with clearly broken-up matte choppy texture and irregular forward fringe, low fade sides. Distinct from a blunt French crop: visibly tousled uneven tips. Generate a new standalone image.
styles.classic_side_part: Style: Classic Side Part. Subject: fictional adult East Asian man with straight black hair. Medium-short 65 mm top neatly combed to one side with a clearly visible natural side part, conservative 18 mm tapered sides, moderate volume, no shaved hard-part line. Generate a new standalone image.
styles.soft_quiff: Style: Soft Quiff. Subject: fictional adult man with fair freckled skin and wavy chestnut hair. Medium 80 mm top with extra front lift swept upward and softly backward, touchable airy separated strands, mid fade sides; not a rigid pompadour. Generate a new standalone image.
styles.low_pompadour: Style: Low Pompadour. Subject: fictional adult man with deep brown skin and dark gently wavy hair. Medium-long top smoothly swept back into a restrained rounded front roll, polished coherent volume rather than messy spikes, low fade sides. Generate a new standalone image.
styles.french_crop: Style: French Crop. Subject: fictional adult man with light skin and straight dark brown hair. Compact 40 mm top brushed forward with a distinct short blunt horizontal fringe well above eyebrows, low faded sides, tidy geometric outline; not a tousled quiff. Generate a new standalone image.
styles.curtain_fringe: Style: Curtain Fringe. Subject: fictional androgynous adult with tan skin and dark wavy hair. Medium-long center-parted curtain fringe opening on the forehead and framing the cheekbones, soft 120 mm top and longer scissor-cut sides, no fade, natural movement. Generate a new standalone image.
styles.caesar_cut: Style: Caesar Cut. Subject: fictional adult man with olive skin and straight dark hair. Short even layered 32 mm top brushed forward into a small soft fringe, visibly fuller 22 mm scissor-cut sides with NO fade or shaved skin. Modest rounded compact shape, distinct from a faded French crop. Generate a new standalone image.
styles.slick_back_taper: Style: Slick Back Taper. Subject: fictional adult man with medium-brown skin and straight black hair. A 100 mm top smoothly combed backward close to the head, restrained low volume with visible parallel comb direction, neat 24 mm tapered sides, no tall pompadour roll. Generate a new standalone image.
styles.rounded_afro_taper: Style: Rounded Afro Taper. Subject: fictional adult Black person with deep brown skin and tightly coily black hair. A softly rounded natural afro with visible dense individual coil texture, approximately 90 mm top and 55 mm sides, gentle neat perimeter taper only, generous balanced rounded silhouette. Generate a new standalone image.
styles.short_curl_taper: Style: Short Curl Taper. Subject: fictional adult man with warm brown skin and tightly curly dark hair. Defined short springy curls on a 55 mm top, gently reduced 20 mm sides and a neat taper around ears; lower compact profile than an afro, not straight hair. Generate a new standalone image.
styles.long_soft_layers: Style: Long Soft Layers. Subject: fictional adult woman with medium tan skin and dark brown wavy hair. Long flowing hair extending just beyond shoulders with subtle layers and face-framing pieces, soft natural movement, no bangs and no fade. Frame to upper chest so all hair ends are visible with generous margin. Generate a new standalone image.
styles.textured_pixie: Style: Textured Pixie. Subject: fictional adult woman with fair skin and auburn hair. Short layered pixie with airy 55 mm crown texture, delicate side-swept fringe and soft 30 mm scissor-cut sides around the ears, no fade or undercut, compact feminine silhouette. Generate a new standalone image.
styles.disconnected_undercut: Style: Disconnected Undercut. Subject: fictional adult man with tan skin and thick dark wavy hair. Long 105 mm top swept loosely back with clear unblended disconnection above very short 6 mm sides, high transition line, bold contrast between the long top and clipped sides. Generate a new standalone image.
